This special issue of the journal Few-Body Systems celebrates Steven Weinberg’s article, “Nuclear Forces from
Chiral Lagrangians,” published in 1990 [1]. The effective ﬁeld theory (EFT) paradigm is among the most
prominent of Steven Weinberg’s legacies. Contemporary with the developments of quantum mechanics, at the
